description: Development questions. Used for tuning the abstention threshold and for inspecting failures. Synthetic, author-reviewed fixtures written against the NimbusDesk corpus - not an independently validated benchmark.
label_convention: relevant_doc_ids lists documents that genuinely contain the answer. reference_fact is a short string that appears in, or directly paraphrases, those documents. Unanswerable questions have an empty relevant_doc_ids list and answerable=false.

questions.question: How long do API keys last before they expire?
questions.reference_fact: API keys expire 90 days after creation by default, up to a maximum of 365 days.

questions.question: What port does NimbusDesk Server listen on by default?
questions.reference_fact: The server listens on port 8787 by default.

questions.question: How many built-in roles does NimbusDesk define?
questions.reference_fact: NimbusDesk defines six built-in roles: Owner, Admin, Maintainer, Contributor, Viewer, Guest.

questions.question: What is the default sustained rate limit for a workspace?
questions.reference_fact: 600 requests per minute per workspace.

questions.question: How many items can a single list response return at most?
questions.reference_fact: limit defaults to 50 and the maximum accepted value is 200.

questions.question: How long is a generated export archive kept before it is deleted?
questions.reference_fact: Export archives are retained for 7 days.

questions.question: How many times does NimbusDesk retry a failed webhook delivery?
questions.reference_fact: Up to 6 retries after the initial attempt, for 7 attempts in total.

questions.question: What is the per-attempt timeout for a webhook delivery?
questions.reference_fact: The per-attempt timeout is 10 seconds, measured to the response headers.

questions.question: What is the minimum PostgreSQL version required by release 2.4?
questions.reference_fact: PostgreSQL 15 is the minimum; 14 and earlier are unsupported.

questions.question: How long are audit log entries retained?
questions.reference_fact: Audit log entries are retained for 400 days.

questions.question: What is the largest page size a listing endpoint will give me?
questions.reference_fact: The maximum accepted limit is 200; larger values are clamped.

questions.question: How much warning do I get before a key stops working?
questions.reference_fact: A Warning: 299 header appears within 7 days of expiry, and the apikey.expiring event fires at the same 7-day mark.

questions.question: How long can a deleted desk still be brought back?
questions.reference_fact: A deleted desk stays in the recycle bin for 30 days and can be restored until the purge.

questions.question: Do workspace tokens expire?
questions.reference_fact: Legacy 2.3 workspace tokens did not expire; that page is superseded, and in 2.4 scoped API keys expire after 90 days by default.

questions.question: Which HTTP header authenticates an API request?
questions.reference_fact: Release 2.4 uses Authorization: Bearer. The superseded 2.3 page describes X-Nimbus-Token, which 2.4 rejects.

questions.question: What is the limit?
questions.reference_fact: Underspecified: the corpus documents request rate limits, pagination limits and per-workspace object limits.

questions.question: How long is the grace period?
questions.reference_fact: Underspecified: key rotation has a 24-hour grace window, workspace deletion a 14-day one, and a renamed slug is reserved for 30 days.

questions.question: What is NimbusDesk's telephone support number?
questions.reference_fact: The corpus never mentions telephone support.

questions.question: How much does a NimbusDesk Enterprise licence cost per seat?
questions.reference_fact: The corpus contains no pricing information.

questions.question: Which cloud regions is NimbusDesk Cloud hosted in?
questions.reference_fact: The corpus never lists hosting regions.
